The problem we are solving is heat loss at {name}. The greenhouse spends an estimated {estimate_point} dollars a year on heating, and much of that heat escapes through the {covering} covering on cold nights. The proposed solution is {top_fix_name}. We chose this project because, of the energy-saving measures assessed for our greenhouse, it offers the largest annual saving, and it can be installed in the existing structure without interrupting production.

Our short-term goals are to install {top_fix_name} across the {sqft} square feet of growing space, to cut heating fuel use from the first heating season after installation, and to lower our operating costs so the farm stays profitable. Burning less fuel also helps mitigate climate change by cutting the greenhouse gas emissions of the operation.

We expect these measurable impacts once the project is complete: heating cost savings of {top_fix_saves_usd} dollars a year, about {gallons_saved} fewer gallons of heating fuel burned each year, and about {carbon_tons_saved} fewer metric tons of carbon dioxide emitted each year. With an estimated project cost of {top_fix_cost_usd}, the payback period in years is {top_fix_payback_years}. We will compare fuel deliveries and heating bills before and after installation to confirm these results.
